payload.reason: The evidence provides a clear comparison of the new Morfessor EM+Prune algorithm against the original recursive training algorithm, highlighting improvements in segmentation accuracy and optimization.

claims.text: The Morfessor EM+Prune algorithm finds better solutions to the optimization problem defined by the Morfessor Baseline model than the original recursive training algorithm.
Morfessor EM+Prune leads to higher morphological segmentation accuracy when compared to a linguistic gold standard.
The new training algorithm reduces search error during training, resulting in models with lower Morfessor costs.
